items.text: I tested positive for COVID-19 last night and am quarantining at home with mild symptoms. I am fully vaccinated and boosted. We all need to do what we can to protect our families, colleagues and healthcare heroes – please get your shots, limit gatherings and mask up. 1/2

@hey_its_me_agan @JohnSarbanes @davidjtrone @RepRaskin I’ve proudly supported and do support federal legislation providing safety measures in hospitals, expanding access to mental health services for healthcare providers and address nurse-to-patient ratios. I have supported federal funding for nursing students. 2/4
@hey_its_me_agan @JohnSarbanes @davidjtrone @RepRaskin I even sponsored legislation to award “hero pay” to our healthcare heroes who work closely with COVID-19 patients. 3/4

Proud to be an original cosponsor of a bipartisan resolution designating the last day of Feb as #RareDiseaseDay. It also:
✔ Recognizes the importance of accurate, early diagnosis.
✔ Reaffirms our commitment to expanding access to + developing new research, treatments + cures. https://t.co/lQIXZ8Apj6
6. $525K for @AshleyTreatment to study + improve substance abuse treatment in #Maryland’s low-income + minority communities. https://t.co/UHzUFIFXR2

This morning, I joined #MarylandHunger in a state-wide “apple crunch” to show my support for healthy school breakfasts + thank the incredible school nutrition staff in #MD02 + across #Maryland working hard to make sure kids are fed every single day. #HeartheCrunch https://t.co/3oImJfOCPv

The ACA continues to strengthen Marylanders’ access to quality health care. It banned insurance companies from discriminating against individuals with pre-existing conditions, protecting 181K Marylanders from being denied coverage over circumstances out of their control. #ThxACA https://t.co/86LrnG81Y4

EDS largely remains a mystery, making accurate diagnoses + management nearly impossible. I introduced a bill designating May #EDSAwarenessMonth to raise awareness of this potentially-fatal genetic disease, reduce discrimination toward patients + inspire research toward a cure.1/2 https://t.co/SuzQuqIKUs

Today, I’m voting yes to the #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act. This bill strengthens more than 30 programs that support mental health care and substance use disorder prevention, care, treatment and recovery support services in American communities incl. #MD02. https://t.co/yU6E6CQrEP

In the wealthiest country in the world, no American should go hungry. Watch today at 10 AM as I join @AppropsDems to mark up a funding bill that tackles hunger and nutrition insecurity with funding for critical programs like WIC, SNAP and school meals: https://t.co/39q9oBoGEN

Proud to secure $3.4M to upgrade the iconic egg-shaped wastewater treatment digesters in #MD02's Essex to bring the plant back into compliance, more effectively treat our wastewater + protect Maryland's natural resources + livelihoods. Learn more: https://t.co/1fYCI0MEIN 1/2 https://t.co/uLV9FTSbon

Proud to secure close to $3M to boost efforts at @CCBCMD, @TowsonU + @gouchercollege to address shortages of teachers, commercial truckers, scientists + healthcare workers for fiscal year 2023. Read the funding breakdown here: https://t.co/QiWEpvXICR https://t.co/hJSH3bu9zb

I often brag that Baltimore is home to the best healthcare in the world + the @MedStarHealth Curtis National Hand Center is no exception. Proud to advance $1.5M for the Center to provide patients w/ even better care, train more specialists + more. More: https://t.co/v7WftxDWat https://t.co/D6Ouq2LPDH

No Veteran should worry about finding a safe place to sleep at night or their next meal. The $1.5M I secured through the THUD funding bill for FY2023 will help make @SheppardPratt's vision of an affordable housing complex and community center for Vets in #MD02 a reality. 1/2 https://t.co/IVs8Sr3NMy

Marylanders, today is primary election day!🦀Polls are open until 8pm. Mail-in ballots must be postmarked or dropped off by 8pm tonight. I urge all of you to exercise your right to #VOTE. Look up your polling location here: https://t.co/f1LsOAmZHB
I tested positive for COVID-19 last evening. My symptoms are mild and I'm working from home while isolating. Thankful to be vaxxed and boosted.

I can’t fathom why Senate Republicans blocked a critical bill (#PACTAct) that veterans exposed to toxins from burn pits and Agent Orange have been fighting YEARS for. If they are against providing healthcare for sick combat vets, what are they FOR? #PeopleOverPolitics

Our economy had 0% inflation in July.  Prices for gas, clothes, air fares, appliances and more all went down. We are on the right track, but still have work to do.  Congress must pass the Inflation Reduction Act ASAP to lower healthcare, prescription drug and energy costs.

Worth noting, small businesses agree the #InflationReductionAct  will ease inflationary pressure by paying down the deficit and reducing costs of healthcare and prescription drugs, which limit small businesses' ability to grow and compete in the labor market. More:
Almost 50 years ago, #SCOTUS ruled that women have the right to make their own very private and often very difficult healthcare decisions...
To commemorate the US Congress passing the #19thAmendment on this day in 1920, I would like to urge all our citizens (women and men) age 18+ to register to vote! Exercise this most basic right...

Super proud to be labeled a "bipartisan champion" by the @commongroundcom, a nonpartisan/nonprofit that helps ID elected officials and candidates that are seeking common ground to move the country forward. Check out coverage from @marylandmatters: https://t.co/9VI1ZqqGBb https://t.co/75tpwVmKn6

Yesterday, #TeamMaryland announced $3 million in federal funds to improve healthcare in rural #Maryland communities. Funds will support a hospital, substance abuse center and efforts to provide healthy, local produce to vulnerable populations. More: https://t.co/IJdHw3jziS https://t.co/UgBeyEmqts

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, 13 million Americans will save an average of $800 per year and $2,400 per family on #ACA health insurance premiums.
Open enrollment began yesterday and goes through Dec. 15. #GetCovered for the start of 2023! More: https://t.co/TUf4ZnYgOJ https://t.co/v8qsDc2YT4
I tested positive for COVID-19 this afternoon. I'm not currently experiencing any symptoms except for mild fatigue. I will be voting by proxy while isolating this week.
